title: Phalaenopsis honghenensis

{{Short description|Species of epiphytic orchid}} {{Speciesbox | image2 = Phalaenopsis honghenensis F.Y.Liu.jpg | image2_caption = Flower details | status = | genus = Phalaenopsis | species = honghenensis | authority = F.Y.Liu | synonyms = *''Doritis honghenensis'' (F.Y.Liu) T.Yukawa & K.Kita | range_map = People's Republic of China Vietnam Locator.png | range_map_caption = Distribution of ''Phalaenopsis honghenensis'' (China and Vietnam) | synonyms_ref = }} '''''Phalaenopsis honghenensis''''', also known as 红河蝴蝶兰 (hong he hu die lan) in Chinese, is a species of orchid native to Southeast China and Vietnam.{{cite web|url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:960380-1|title=''Phalaenopsis honghenensis'' F.Y.Liu | Plants of the World Online | Kew Science|website=powo.science.kew.org|access-date=3 March 2022}} The specific epithet ''honghenensis'' refers to [[Honghe County|Honghe]], China. ==Description== Like other members of ''Phalaenopsis'' section ''Aphyllae'', this plant exhibits deciduous leaflessness. However, it usually has 1–2 leaves, which are produced on up to 1 cm long stems, which are imbricated in leaf bases. The 5–7 cm long and 1.5–2.5 cm wide leaves are obliquely elliptic and show purple spotting. Verrucose, photosynthetic adventitious roots radiate from the stem. Pink to pale green, 2.9 cm wide flowers are produced on 3–6 flowered, up to 7.7 cm long racemes. A small spur is produced by the labellum.Raven, P. H., Wu, Z. (1998). [http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=242336950 "Flora of China: Orchidaceae."] p. 479, 481. United States: Science Press. == Gallery == File:Phalaenopsis honghenensis F.Y.Liu flower bud lateral view.jpg|Lateral view of flower bud of ''Phalaenopsis honghenensis'' F.Y.Liu with distinct spur File:Phalaenopsis honghenensis F.Y.Liu flower bud.jpg|Flower bud of ''Phalaenopsis honghenensis'' F.Y.Liu File:Phalaenopsis honghenensis F.Y.Liu flower viewed from behind.jpg|Fully opened flower of ''Phalaenopsis honghenensis'' F.Y.Liu viewed from behind ==Taxonomy== The variable colouration may be a source of confusion. The flowers may be rose pink or infused with green.
The true phylogenetic relationships within the section ''Aphyllae'' are subject of dispute, which is fueled by confusion caused through various authors describing and synonymizing species within this group. Thus, species delimitation and identification is a complex matter.Dalström, S. (2006). Notes from the OIC: It Is Not Easy Being Green. Selbyana, 27(2), 208–214. http://www.jstor.org/stable/41760284 ==Ecology== This species grows in elevations of 2000 m above sea level. ==Conservation== International trade is regulated through the CITES appendix II regulations of international trade.{{Cite web|url=https://cites.org/eng/taxonomy/term/33584|title=Phalaenopsis|website=CITES}} ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Taxonbar|from=Q4046795}} [[Category:Phalaenopsis|honghenensis]] [[Category:Orchids of China]] [[Category:Orchids of Vietnam]] [[Category:Flora of Vietnam]] [[Category:Flora of China]] {{Phalaenopsis-stub}}
